name: ActionButton
description: ActionButton component with confirmation popover or dialog

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner on the trigger button

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class for the trigger button

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the trigger button

fields.name: title
fields.description: Heading shown in the confirmation UI

fields.name: confirmLabel
fields.description: Label for the confirm button. Defaults to `'OK'` in popover mode and `'Confirm'` in dialog mode

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Icon shown in the popover header (popover mode only)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Body text or node shown below the title
